paragraphs: Thank you for confirming the order for twelve oak window frames. Our surveyor will measure the openings on Monday morning.
The frames will be made in our workshop over three weeks and fitted in two days, weather permitting.
A deposit of 30% is due before work begins; the balance falls due within fourteen days of fitting.
Please call Priya Shah if the access arrangements change.

notes-pymupdf.pdf.text: Site meeting notes for the Tannery Yard workshop extension Present: Tom Ellery, Priya Shah and the building inspector. The inspector approved the foundation depth and asked for a second fire exit on the east wall. Priya will order the steel lintels this week; delivery is expected before the end of the month. Open questions: drainage on the north side, and whether the old kiln chimney can stay.

mail-1.eml.subject: Lintel order confirmed
mail-1.eml.text:
Tom,

The steel lintels are ordered and due on the 24th.
I have asked the yard to keep the east gate clear.

Priya

mail-2.eml.subject: Survey on Monday — café entrance
mail-2.eml.text:
Dear Ms Okafor,

Our surveyor will arrive at 9 am and use the café entrance.
The visit takes about an hour.

Tom

mail-3.eml.text:
Hello Tom,

Does the quote for the four sash windows include the glass?
Kind regards,
Lena
